title: Delicate Russian Stir Fry
description: A light and flavorful stir fry dish with delicate vegetables, inspired by traditional Russian cuisine.
instructions: Heat almond oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add delicate mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Add yellow bell pepper and stir-fry sauce, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
